prerequisites: Knowledge of Materials Resistance (recommended to have taken previously)

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding and interpretation of texts and data, development of skills for their concretization and clear and concise presentation.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and time and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for finding sustainable engineering solutions.
Ability for collaborative work and capacity for the development of multidisciplinary projects.
Knowledge and capacities for the calculation, design and testing of machines.

syllabus_topics: Meaning of the design concept in mechanical engineering
Codes and standards. Review of unit systems
Selection criteria in mechanical engineering design (bearings, ...)
Theories of static failure for brittle or ductile materials
Application to machine elements (pressurization and curved elements)
Concept of fatigue failure. Types of variable loads
Stress duration. Concept of infinite life
Determination of the stress limit for infinite life
Surface fatigue. Aspects related to fracture mechanics
Pre-stressed joints, Preload. Fatigue in bolted joints
Pre-stressed joints with and without gaskets
Characteristics of materials used in their manufacture
teaching_methods: Lectures (exposing basic fundamentals, calculation theories, and theoretical formulation)
Personal work (individual and group exercises and proposed assignments, both in-class and non-presential)
Practices (laboratory and computer-based, introducing the Finite Element Method)
assessment_rules: For the grades of the assessable tests to be averaged and thus pass the course, a minimum passing grade of 5 must be obtained in each of them.
